title: How to organise the crib and sleep zone | Nursery
description:
The one surface in the house where your baby is left alone, which is why it holds a fitted sheet and nothing more.

This is the Crib and Sleep Zone in the Nursery. About 15-30 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
A bare mattress with one fitted sheet pulled tight to the corners, the sleep sack folded on the dresser, the monitor mounted on the wall with its cable clipped high and at least an arm's length back from the rails, and nothing draped over the top rail.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Lift everything out of the crib and lay it on the floor where you can see it at once: the quilt, the plush pil
Straighten: Put the spares where your hand finds them in the dark.
Shine: Strip and hot-wash the sheet, then wipe the mattress cover and every rail, especially the top rail where hands
Safety: Drop the mattress to its lowest setting the day your baby can push up onto hands and knees, because the next t
Standardize: Photograph the empty crib with its single sheet and tape the picture inside the closet door.
Sustain: Every time the sheet comes off for the wash, the crib goes back together with a sheet and nothing else.

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
The crib holds a fitted sheet, a sleep sack, and your baby.

Full written steps for this zone, free:
https://6s-success.com/zones/nursery-the-crib-and-sleep-zone.html
